title: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Canggu Bali
metaTitle: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Canggu Bali
metaDescription: Be a part of our 200 hour yoga teacher training in Canggu Bali to take your experience to a whole new level on a mental, physical and spiritual note. Aimed to give a pragmatic approach to it all, our residential course program, under the tutelage of experienced facilitators
summary: Based on the ancient teachings of Hatha Yoga, Ashtanga Yoga and Vinyasa flow, covering asanas, kriya, pranayama, meditation, anatomy, bandhas, yoga philosophy and teaching methodology.
intro: Based on the ancient teachings of Hatha Yoga, Ashtanga Yoga and Vinyasa flow, all our courses aim to deliver the authentic teachings of yoga in its original form 'as it is.' The course also features the various aspects of the subject that include asanas, kriya, pranayama and meditation, anatomy, bandhas, yoga philosophy and teaching methodology.

We accept a maximum number of 25 to 30 students in the course. We ensure that the class should be conducted in a pious environment and good enough to offer you a dynamic, engaging and holistic experience.
The whole yoga teacher training course is in English. You should have at least a minimum understanding of English.

curriculum.title: Ashtanga Yoga Postures
curriculum.summary: In 200 hours yoga TTC we teach our students basics of Ashtanga yoga and guide them through the complete Ashtanga yoga primary series (sequence by K. Pattabhi Jois) in a systematic way according to the Ashtanga yoga tradition.
items: Mysore style/ use of yoga props/ Teaching practice
On 1st week- introduction to Ashtanga yoga followed by Sun salutation A & B.
On 2nd week – Standing sequence postures & use of yoga props.
On 3rd week – Seated sequence postures & Finishing sequence postures.
On 4th week – Mysore style & Teaching practice.

curriculum.title: Hatha Yoga / Alignment & Adjustment / Teaching Methodology Topics
items: Aim and Objectives of Hatha Yoga

curriculum.title: Yoga Philosophy (Yoga Darshana)
items: What is Yoga, Meaning, and Goal?
An Overview of Patanjali Yoga Sutras’ All Chapters
Understanding All the 4 Paths of Yoga
Trigunas (Concept of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas)
What are the Pancha-Kosha In Yoga
What are the Chakras in Yoga

curriculum.title: Yoga Anatomy & Physiology
items: 1st week: Meaning & Importance / Introduction of anatomy & physiology
1st week: Introduction of skeleton structure & functions
1st week: Bone anatomy & human skeleton system
1st week: Important names of human skeleton system
1st week: Angular movements of human body
1st week: Assignment paper submission/ activities/ exercises
2nd week: Function of all types of joints
2nd week: Types of synovial joints & their functions
2nd week: Types of cartilage & connective tissues
3rd week: Human Cells, Types of Tissues, Organs
4th week: Presentation on any topic to anatomy teacher.

fees.note: In order to book the course, you are required to deposit the booking fee. We accept booking fee via Razorpay | Western Union | bank transfer or TransferWise. An official booking confirmation letter will be sent to you shortly after successful advance deposit for the course fees; the balance of the course fees can be paid on arrival at school either by credit card, debit card or cash.

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. By following a plant-based diet during your training, you are in the practice of ahimsa.
mealTimes: Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 10:00 am with the opening ceremony & orientation program. In order to attend the opening ceremony of the course you should arrive at school a day before the starting date of the course. The course completes on 25th of every month at 7:00 pm with graduation & fire ceremony performed by the graduates & their masters. Departure date is 25th of every month before 12:00 pm.

Our 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training in Canggu, Bali begins on the 1st of every month at 5:00 PM with an opening ceremony and orientation. The course concludes on the 6th of every month. To ensure you are well-rested before the training begins, we recommend arriving one day earlier. Check-in is available between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM, and we offer a complimentary night's stay before the course starts. On the final day, check-out should be completed between 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM.

The closest and most convenient airport is Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS), Denpasar, located approximately 20 km from our Canggu campus. Once you have booked your flight, simply share your arrival details with us, and we will arrange an airport pickup.

Complimentary pickup from DPS (I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport) is included in your course fee. Please send us your flight information after booking so we can organize your transfer smoothly.
prerequisites: You should have at least a minimum understanding of English (the whole course is in English).
A high degree of self-motivation is required for all aspects of the course. The practice and especially the teaching of yoga demand a high degree of self-discipline and purity.

policies.title: Dress code for opening and graduation ceremony
items: Keep 1 or 2 pairs of white clothes for the opening and graduation ceremony of the course.

policies.title: Class Attendance
items: All classes are mandatory; only in case of an emergency or illness one can take leave with the respective teacher's permission. Uninformed leaves won't be accepted and this will leave a bad impression on the student's monthly performance.

policies.title: Course Rules
items: Participants are required to attend all spiritual activities, meditation sessions, lectures and asana classes.
Meat, fish, eggs, black tea, coffee, alcohol, tobacco, drugs and nudity are prohibited during the course as they are counterproductive to the yoga practice.
Participants who do not comply with the school rules may be dismissed from the course.

policies.title: Discipline Rules for Students
items: Smoking and alcohol are strictly prohibited in the school.
If you are having a fast any day, you have to inform the kitchen manager to avoid food waste.
Always maintain discipline, respect teachers and follow all rules. Always be on time; if you are late you will not be permitted to join class.
Clear your books of account before departure from Himalayan Yoga Association. Before departure return your books, maps or any goods which you borrowed.

Himalayan Yoga Association provides accommodation for a student who joins the yoga course. Friends or relatives will not be included in accommodation; however they can stay in school by renting another room.
Students have to be present in all scheduled programs of Himalayan Yoga Association.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: The course fees & booking amount will not be refundable; only in the case of emergency students can join us on other schedules.
If a student cancels the course after joining it, we accept cancellation but course fees will not be refunded.
